summary: Backend-only verification for the DB cleanup + startup purge. All 6 new purge-verification tests PASS. The 37 existing regression tests (test_push_pipeline.py, test_push_edge_cases.py, test_iteration6_regression.py) still PASS. Confirmed: (1) /api/admin/users returns exactly ONE user, the founder semidiepie@gmail.com — no test_/tec_/tpb_/TEST_ leftovers. (2) /api/feed, /api/reels, /api/stories contain no orphan content. (3) Founder login returns a valid JWT. (4) A scratch user registered as test_purge_check@example.com is visible before restart and is auto-purged (along with its token being invalidated) after `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. purge_legacy_seed_data() works as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: purge_legacy_seed_data() covers all requested collections (posts, comments, likes, follows, notifications, conversations, messages, blocks, reports, stories, story_views, push_tokens, moderation_events, live_sessions) plus reset_codes and a good orphan-cleanup pass. Implementation matches PR description.
Note: server.py is 1921 lines — recommend splitting into routers/services in a future iteration (>700 line threshold). Not a blocker for this task.
seed_data_creation: Test registers one scratch user test_purge_check@example.com and relies on the startup purge to remove it. No lingering data after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend port 8001 via supervisor. Frontend .env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Founder: semidiepie@gmail.com / Semi123!. Registration schema requires display_name (not name). Reel author id lives under `author.id`, not top-level `author_id`. The startup purge deletes any user with email/username matching ^(test_|TEST_|tec_|tpb_) case-insensitively, so any scratch account you create for a test run will be gone after the next backend restart — this is intended.
